tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Lotus white with a slight teal bias in light; deep teal-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, terminal blocks and inputs set on `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers between rows. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: buttons, inputs, pickers. Never use `line` alone as a control's edge. 3.2:1 on `surface-raised` and 3.0:1 on `surface` in light; 3.3:1 on `surface-raised` and 3.7:1 on `surface` in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and command text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `tint` (15:1 light, 13.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps and prompts (`$`) on `surface` and `surface-raised` (6.2:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: freeMiele teal, the complement of Miele red (hue 174 vs 351). Primary buttons, links, the 'Ready' state. As text on `surface`/`surface-raised` 6:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill (6.4:1 light, 7.6:1 dark). Dark text in dark theme, because the brand lightens there.

tokens.name: crema
tokens.usage: Accent: espresso crema copper, analogous to Miele red (hue 23). Running/brewing progress, highlights, the one warm note on a screen. As text on `surface` 5:1 light, 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-crema
tokens.usage: Text on a `crema` fill (5.4:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Soft teal fill for selected rows, the cover's relief block and code highlights. `ink` reads on it (11:1 light, 9.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: 'Needs attention' and 'Mobile start off' text and icons on `surface`/`surface-raised` (5.9:1 light, 8.5:1 dark). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: 'Fault' and error text on `surface`/`surface-raised` (6.1:1 light, 7.2:1 dark). Kept small: freeMiele never uses red as a brand colour. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 6:1 on `surface` light, 8.4:1 dark.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the app's main state or the page hero.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, status headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Turn on Mobile Start at the machine, then run this again.
styles.usage: Running text, help and error explanations.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status chips and uppercase field labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; chip inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows and between chips; button padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phones, gap between rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; the cover's grid pitch.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks: crisp, like an appliance's touch keys. Mac app exception: 8px for buttons, inputs and pickers on macOS, to match the system's control shape; other surfaces keep 4px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips. In SVG use half the shape's short side instead.
